meta.name: Bad Man of Deadwood
meta.description:
Roy Rogers, George "Gabby" Hayes, and Sally Payne are members of "Professor Blackstone's Medicine Show". 
Their offering of tuneful entertainment and elixir receives a poor reception in the town of Deadwood, led by Bad Man Hal Taliaferro (as Ripper). 
They decide to stick around and extinguish the "Bad Man of Deadwood" and his wicked gang.
